outcome: adverse neonatal composite (very low birthweight, very preterm birth, severe neonatal asphyxia or death)
cohort: The study included 23,899 pregnant women who delivered in Chengdu, China, between January 2017 and December 2019.
finding: A long interpregnancy interval (IPI) was associated with an increased risk of small-for-gestational age (SGA), full-term low birthweight (LBW), and preterm birth (PTB), irrespective of maternal age.
